l: The Patrol Bureau is responsible for Field Training Program, Patrol Command, and Traffic Division. Patrol is divided into two commands, the North Command and South Command which are responsible for directing and coordinating the respective Patrol Operations Divisions.

A. Field Training Program - provides a standardized program to facilitate the transition from the academic setting of the Police Academy to the actual performance of law enforcement duties in the field.

North Command shall consist of North Division, Northwest Division, West Division and Traffic Division. South Command shall consist of South Division, East Division, Central Division, and Community Alliance Division. Each North and South Command has a Command Inspections Division.
A. Each patrol division has a Community Operations Section including:

1. Criminal Investigation Unit - responsible for the investigation of all offenses not covered by special units, including but not limited to, auto theft, burglary, theft, fraud (under $150,000) and general assignments.

2. Crime Prevention Unit - provides support to each of the division crime prevention specialists and neighborhood police officers; designs, researches, and produces crime prevention literature; and coordinates various crime prevention programs.

B. Each patrol division has Neighborhood Police Officers (NPO) who incorporate non-traditional methods of crime prevention aimed at the inclusion of neighborhoods and the community, promoting an open channel of communication between the police department and the community to effectively eliminate or reduce crime.
C. Additional programs included within specific Patrol Divisions:
a. Downtown Traffic Control - responsible for traffic control within the central business district.
b. Bicycle Patrol Unit - provide concentrated patrol to deter street crime and increase the public perception of safety for citizens in the downtown business district of Central Division.

c. Animal Cruelty Detective - investigates of all animal cruelty offenses reported to the Fort Worth Police Department. This detective also investigates any offenses involving animal fight events and animal bites.
a. Metal Theft – works with entities that use metal in the course of their business to help reduce crime and to maintain compliance utilizing State Law and City Ordinance.

b. Stockyards Team- ensure public safety, increase positive interactions with the public and maintain a professional appearance in the Stockyards Business District (SYBD) while supporting the Department’s overall mission.

a. West 7th Patrol Team - creates a safer environment for the West 7th Urban Village, the Museum and Arts District, Botanic Gardens, and Dickies’ Arena by proactively pursuing crime reduction strategies, especially alcohol-related offenses.

Under North Command, the Traffic Division shall have primary responsibility for follow-up investigation of traffic accidents to include hit and runs; enforcing traffic laws, and regulating traffic movement; direct, coordinate, and supervise the activities of assigned traffic control technicians; provide follow-up investigation and case filing for traffic offenses; and, responsible for breath/blood/urine tests on all fatality accidents involving a city vehicle driven by an on-duty or off-duty police department employee.
